case.presentation: 57 year old male with no significant past medical history and a 20 pack year smoking history, having quit 8 years prior, presents with a single 4mm ground-glass nodule in the LLL.
case.context: CT lumbar spine obtained for pre-operative evaluation of lumbar degenerative disease. No prior imaging.

ground_truth.notes: Maintainer assigned low risk: 20-pack-year former smoker, quit 8 years prior — below Fleischner's quoted 30-pack-year heavy-smoker threshold for high-risk classification in patients with solid nodules (§'Tobacco and Other Inhaled Carcinogens'). Oracle's conservative heuristic flags any smoking history as high. Bin is risk-invariant per Table 1B (subsolid <6mm = no routine follow-up regardless of risk).
